title: Chase letter after June 1967 meeting of base UFO officers
place_text: United States Air Force / Condon Committee

tellings.quote: >> And then there was another letter that Chase had written after having a big meeting in June of ' 67 with other base UFO officers

plain: In June 1967, the Air Force officers handling UFO reports at various bases held a big meeting, and afterwards a man named Lewis Chase wrote a letter about it. That is what Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, tells Michels, citing the letter as one of several documents from that period. It would mean the subject was being discussed among the people at the bases who handled the reports.
